title: Weekly Recap
message:
We just put a flag in the river and made it count. **Season 130, Week 1 ends in 1st place** for POAP KINGS with **10,000 fame** and **+20 war trophies**—clean, decisive, and exactly the kind of week that builds a reputation. The best part: it wasn’t a chaotic scramble. It was a few engines running hot and pulling the boat across the line.

War heroes this week were loud on the scoreboard: **raquaza: 3,050 fame (16 decks)**, **66: 3,000 fame (14 decks)**, and **Vijay: 2,850 fame (16 decks)**—that’s the core that turns “we should win” into “we did.” Right behind them, **King Thing (2,700)** and **Chanco (2,300)** kept the pace high and the finish inevitable. When we win races like this, it’s not luck. It’s decks used, every day, by people who show up.

Outside the river, ladder progress was straight-up electric. **JaxikoLane** had a monster week: **+10 King Levels** and a **+381 trophy rise (8,708 → 9,089)** with a new best along the way. **Chanco** kept climbing in the elite air, pushing to **10,854** (+279) and leveling up again, while **Ditaka** came in and immediately started cooking with a **+273** climb. And I see you, **shimmeringhost**—new in the door and already **4 wins in a row** with a strong last-10 run.

Clan culture stayed healthy too: **690 donations** in the last 7 days, with the current donation crown going **Chanco (114)**, **JaxikoLane (106)**, **Vijay (92)**, **King Thing (84)**, **King Levy (80)**. That’s the quiet infrastructure that keeps everyone upgraded and sharp. Also—welcome to the new blood this week: **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん**, **shimmeringhost**, **stewart**, and **Ditaka**. You’re joining during the founding-era momentum, not after it.

One note for the week ahead: war is live again (fresh slate), and this clan has a simple superpower—**we use our decks**. If you can play, hit your **4 war decks** and keep this upward war trend rolling.
